face.name: YuNet 2023mar
face.reference: Pinned OpenCV model ONNX; OpenCV 4.11.0 FaceDetectorYN for decoded boxes and five landmarks

preprocessing.resize: fit within 640x640; preserve aspect ratio; pad bottom/right with zero

face.outputs_semantics: box xywh and right eye, left eye, nose tip, right mouth corner, left mouth corner; score=sqrt(clamped cls * clamped obj)

face_identity.name: ArcFace MobileNetV1 official CASIA-WebFace v1.1

preprocessing.alignment: Existing five-point similarity alignment to 112px; geometric frontend is retained
preprocessing.source: Pinned utils/utils.py preprocess_input and Arcface detect_image

face_identity.output_semantics: 512D L2-normalized face embedding. Labels are a local experimental matching feature, never authorization.

gallery_policy.scope: Development matching policy: cosine >= .5 (unit-vector Euclidean <= 1). Separate from historical SFace threshold; not field-calibrated FAR/FRR.

expression.license: Apache-2.0 declared in model README; its LICENSE link is absent both in HF mirror and model subdirectory; the pinned upstream root license is retained

detection_segmentation.license: AGPL-3.0, matching the existing Ultralytics detector dependency

head_pose.name: head-pose-estimation-adas-0001
head_pose.license: Apache-2.0 as referenced by official model.yml

preprocessing.pixel_transform: uint8 BGR crop resized with OpenCV INTER_LINEAR, cast to float32 without external normalization
preprocessing.roi: clipped integer face box in source RGB coordinates

head_pose.output_semantics: fc_y/fc_p/fc_r are yaw/pitch/roll degrees; supported yaw [-90,90], pitch/roll [-70,70]

gaze.name: gaze-estimation-adas-0002
gaze.license: Apache-2.0 as referenced by official model.yml

preprocessing.inputs: two 60x60 eye crops and yaw/pitch/roll [1,3] degrees
preprocessing.eye_crop: OMZ35 corner pairs 0/1 and 2/3; square side 1.8*corner distance; reject outside/too-small crops
preprocessing.roll_alignment: warp each eye around integer center with roll degrees and BORDER_REPLICATE; supply head roll=0; compensate vector rotation afterward

gaze.output_semantics: Normalize gaze vector, undo roll, then use OMZ demo yaw=90+atan2(z,x) wrapped to [-180,180), pitch=asin(y/norm), both in degrees. Zero yaw follows model -Z. No calibrated camera/world ray is claimed.

person_reid.name: OSNet x1.0 MSMT17 combineall official

preprocessing.resize: Pillow 12.3.0 bilinear to fixed 128x256; Torchreid evaluation transform

person_reid.output_semantics: 512D OSNet MSMT17 appearance features; L2 normalization and model-specific embedding space. Tracking/association remains separate.

object_embedding.name: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 image encoder

preprocessing.resize: Pillow 12.3.0 bicubic shortest side 224 then centered 224 crop; OpenAI CLIP transform

object_embedding.output_semantics: 512D CLIP image-encoder features, L2 normalized. General appearance/semantic features, not universal instance identity; measured association cases are still required.
